content.name: Danielle Okafor
content.title: Marketing Manager
content.summary: Marketing manager three years out of UT Austin, running the full marketing function for a two-store independent pet supply retailer. Built its email and loyalty program from zero to 9,400 members and tied every campaign to point-of-sale data, lifting repeat purchases 18% in the first year.

experience.title: Marketing Manager
bullets: Own a $140,000 annual marketing budget across paid social, local radio, events and in-store signage, reporting monthly ROI to the two owners.
Launched a points-based loyalty program in Klaviyo that reached 9,400 members in 14 months and now drives 46% of total sales.
Organized six adoption weekends with three Travis County rescue groups, bringing 2,100 visitors and $38,000 in same-weekend revenue.
Cut cost per new customer from $31 to $22 by moving spend from broad Facebook audiences to ZIP-code targeted Instagram and Google Local ads.
Hired and direct a part-time content creator and a freelance designer, setting a weekly production calendar of 12 posts and two emails.

experience.title: Marketing Coordinator
bullets: Coordinated seasonal HVAC tune-up campaigns across direct mail, Google Ads and door hangers, booking 1,350 service appointments in spring 2024.
Rebuilt the landing pages for four service lines in WordPress, raising form completion from 3.1% to 5.4% over two quarters.
Pulled weekly lead-source reports from ServiceTitan so the sales manager could drop two underperforming lead vendors and save $2,600 a month.
Managed 90+ Google Business Profile reviews a quarter, responding within 24 hours and lifting the average rating from 4.3 to 4.7.

education.school: The University of Texas at Austin, McCombs School of Business
education.details: GPA 3.6/4.0. Senior capstone: go-to-market plan for a local kombucha brewer, adopted for its 2023 grocery launch.

achievements.title: Capstone client adoption
achievements.detail: Student team's go-to-market plan was used by a local beverage startup for its first grocery listing.

achievements.title: Loyalty launch on budget
achievements.detail: Delivered the loyalty program for under $6,000 in setup costs, including staff training at both stores.
